name: Umbraco CMS
description_en:
Umbraco CMS is an open-source .NET content management system. Its official product documentation distinguishes the self-hosted CMS from managed Umbraco Cloud and the separate Heartcore headless service. Content is structured through document, media and member types rather than a fixed website template alone.

The readable documentation currently identifies itself as CMS 18.latest. A deployment evaluation should use the requirements for that version, model a representative content type and check publishing and hosting behavior. Older search excerpts for another major version are not a substitute for those requirements.
description_zh:
Umbraco CMS 是开源 .NET 内容管理系统。官方产品文档区分了自行托管的 CMS、托管服务 Umbraco Cloud 及独立的 Heartcore 无头服务。内容通过文档、媒体和成员类型建模，并非只依赖固定网站模板。

本轮可读文档标为 CMS 18.latest。部署评估应使用该版本的要求，建立有代表性的内容类型，再检查发布与托管行为；其他大版本的旧搜索摘要不能替代当前要求。

core_features.explanation_en: Document, media and member types organize fields and reusable content structure.
core_features.explanation_zh: 文档、媒体及成员类型组织字段和可复用内容结构。

core_features.explanation_en: Documentation covers scheduled publishing, translation dictionaries and version comparison or rollback.
core_features.explanation_zh: 文档介绍定时发布、翻译词典及版本比较和回退。

core_features.explanation_en: The MIT-licensed CMS can be installed freely; Cloud and Heartcore are distinct managed offerings.
core_features.explanation_zh: MIT 许可的 CMS 可免费安装，Cloud 与 Heartcore 是不同的托管产品。

pricing.notes_en: Self-hosted CMS software is free/MIT. Hosting, operations, support and paid services are separate; their prices are unverified.
pricing.notes_zh: 自行托管的 CMS 软件免费并使用 MIT；托管、运维、支持及付费服务另计，金额未核实。

sources.research_notes_en: Official overview states CMS is free to install, set up and self-host; paid managed services are separate.

official_check.scope: Public primary sources read; no account, purchase, integration execution, performance benchmark, owner identity or publication approval tested.

review_notes: Original English synthesis and corresponding Chinese translation from the attached primary sources. Vendor documentation does not establish independent testing or customer outcomes.
Original directory feature labels were replaced with product-specific documented capabilities. Unknowns and unreviewed alternatives remain unknown.

sections.title_zh: 建立实际编辑对象的模型
sections.en: A Document Type defines page content, a Media Type describes media fields and a Member Type describes member-profile fields. Data Types, property editors and compositions provide reusable building blocks. For example, an editorial pilot could define a product page with a title, body and image, then check how an editor fills those fields. That is an illustrative model, not an executed installation or a bundled commerce system.
sections.zh: Document Type 定义页面内容，Media Type 描述媒体字段，Member Type 描述成员档案字段；Data Type、属性编辑器和组合提供复用基础。编辑试点可建立含标题、正文和图片的产品页面，再检查编辑人员如何填写字段。这是示例模型，未实际安装，也不表示默认包含电商系统。

sections.en: The publishing documentation covers scheduling, dictionary translations and version comparison or rollback. Do not confuse these capabilities with entitlement to every separately sold approval or workflow product. The product overview also distinguishes the CMS Content Delivery API from Heartcore: headless delivery does not by itself mean a Heartcore subscription, and Heartcore’s managed REST/GraphQL service is not proof that all such services are included in a self-hosted install.
sections.zh: 发布文档包含定时发布、词典翻译及版本比较和回退；不能因此推断所有另售审批或工作流产品均已包含。产品总览还区分 CMS Content Delivery API 与 Heartcore：无头交付不必然意味着订阅 Heartcore，Heartcore 托管 REST/GraphQL 服务也不能证明自行安装版本包含全部同类服务。

sections.en: The 18.latest requirements page lists .NET 10.0 or higher, Node.js 24.11.1 or higher, and SQLite or SQL Server; SQL Server naming must use a case-insensitive collation. Installation documentation uses .NET templates and Central Package Management via Directory.Packages.props. A developer should first resolve SDK, database and template prerequisites, then test a local site and its HTTPS setup. No commands were run in this research.
sections.zh: 18.latest 要求页列出 .NET 10.0 及以上、Node.js 24.11.1 及以上，以及 SQLite 或 SQL Server；SQL Server 命名需采用不区分大小写的排序规则。安装文档使用 .NET 模板，并通过 Directory.Packages.props 集中管理包。开发者应先核对 SDK、数据库及模板依赖，再测试本地站点和 HTTPS；本轮没有执行安装命令。

sections.title_en: Free software still needs hosting and operations
sections.title_zh: 免费软件仍需托管与运维
sections.en: The official overview identifies Umbraco CMS as MIT licensed and free to install, set up and self-host. This establishes the software licensing boundary, not zero total operating cost. Hosting, backups, upgrades, development and optional products remain separate evaluation items. The same overview describes a 14-day Umbraco Cloud trial; a trial does not establish sustained free managed hosting. Current paid Cloud, Heartcore and add-on prices were not verified.
sections.zh: 官方总览说明 Umbraco CMS 使用 MIT 许可，可免费安装、配置及自行托管。这确认的是软件许可边界，并非总运营成本为零；托管、备份、升级、开发及可选产品仍需单独评估。同页介绍 Umbraco Cloud 的 14 天试用，试用不代表长期免费托管。当前 Cloud、Heartcore 与附加产品价格未核实。

sections.en: The requirements page explains database read/write permissions and additional schema-change privileges for installation or upgrades. Backoffice preview and server events use SignalR; hosts that buffer streaming responses can break the SSE fallback, while WebSockets are preferred. This is a developer-operated CMS option for teams able to maintain .NET hosting. A team requiring a fully operated service should evaluate Cloud separately. Backup restoration, upgrades, access-control isolation and performance remain untested.
sections.zh: 要求页说明数据库读写权限，以及安装或升级时所需的额外结构修改权限。后台预览及服务器事件使用 SignalR，缓冲流响应的托管环境可能破坏 SSE 回退，优先使用 WebSockets。该 CMS 适合能够维护 .NET 托管的团队；需要完整代运维服务的团队应另评估 Cloud。备份恢复、升级、权限隔离及性能仍未实测。

content_method.method: Public primary-source research, original English editorial synthesis and Chinese translation. Hypothetical examples are not executed tests.

research_gaps.en: Paid hosting, support, Heartcore and extension prices remain unverified; MIT does not make those services free.
research_gaps.zh: 付费托管、支持、Heartcore 及扩展价格未核实，MIT 不代表这些服务免费。

research_gaps.en: Installation, updates, data migration, restore, API authorization and load behavior were not tested.
research_gaps.zh: 未测试安装、更新、数据迁移、恢复、API 授权及负载表现。
